topic: Calling the Office about a Sick Kid

script.title: SICK CALL AT WORK
script.scene_zh: 公司電話 · 請假報備
script.story_hook: A dad calls his boss about his sick son.
script.intro_zh: 一位爸爸打電話給主管，說兒子生病了。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we phone a boss about a sick child. Listen for polite call phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們練習打電話給主管。留意有禮貌的請假說法。
script.outro: The meeting has a plan, and the kid is resting.
script.outro_zh: 會議有了安排，孩子也在休息。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each polite phone phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句跟讀這些電話說法。
script.char_a_description: a man in his early thirties with short black hair and a thin mustache, wearing a soft blue sweater over a gray collared shirt, dark pants and brown loafers, average build
script.char_b_description: a woman in her fifties with silver hair pulled into a low bun, wearing a deep purple blazer, gold earrings, black slacks and low heels, upright and calm

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, Diane. Sorry to call so early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ daɪæn ˈsɑɹi tə kɔl soʊ ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: 早安，黛安。很抱歉這麼早打來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, hello Kevin. Is everything okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ hɛˈloʊ ˈkɛvɪn ɪz ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，嗨凱文。你還好吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not really. I'm calling about a sick day.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈɹɪli aɪm ˈkɔlɪŋ əˈbaʊt ə sɪk deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不太妙。我想為請病假打這通電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. Are you feeling bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ɑɹ ju ˈfilɪŋ bæd/
dialogue.zh: 噢不。是你身體不舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's actually my son, Leo. He has a fever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈæktʃuəli maɪ sʌn ˈlioʊ hi hæz ə ˈfivɚ/
dialogue.zh: 其實是我兒子利奧，他在發燒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How bad is the fever?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ bæd ɪz ðə ˈfivɚ/
dialogue.zh: 燒得兇嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hundred two this morning. He slept very little.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈhʌndrəd tu ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ hi slɛpt ˈvɛɹi ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 今早燒到一百零二度，他幾乎沒睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poor kid. So you can't come in?
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊɹ kɪd soʊ ju kænt kʌm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 可憐的孩子。所以你今天到不了公司？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. The school sent him home at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ðə skul sɛnt hɪm hoʊm æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，學校九點就把他送回了家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fair. Family first, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛɹ ˈfæməli fɜɹst ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這是應該的。家人永遠擺第一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for understanding. Um, about today…
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔɹ ˌʌndɚˈstændɪŋ ʌm əˈbaʊt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的體諒。呃，關於今天……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, ask. It's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd æsk ɪts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 直說無妨，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I work from home this afternoon?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ wɜɹk fɹʌm hoʊm ðɪs ˌæftɚˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 今天下午我可以在家辦公嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, if you feel up to it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɪf ju fil ʌp tə ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，只要你精神撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little. He'll nap, then I'll log on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl hil næp ðɛn aɪ lɑɡ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 還行。他午睡之後我就上線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan. What about the ten o'clock meeting?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd plæn wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə tɛn əˈklɑk ˈmitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好打算。那十點的會議怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the tricky part, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈtɹɪki pɑɹt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，為難的就是這一場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You run that one with the clients.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɹʌn ðæt wʌn wɪθ ðə ˈklaɪənts/
dialogue.zh: 那場面對客戶，輪由你主持。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know. May I present it from home?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ meɪ aɪ pɹɪˈzɛnt ɪt fɹʌm hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我知道。我可以在家裡簡報嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On video? With him sick at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ˈvidioʊ wɪθ hɪm sɪk æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 開視訊？孩子還病著就在家裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I'll sit far from him. Masks, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ sɪt fɑɹ fɹʌm hɪm mæks tu/
dialogue.zh: 我會坐得離他遠一點，也戴口罩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm. One second, let me think.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm wʌn ˈsɛkənd lɛt mi θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，稍等，讓我想想。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course. Or I can swap with Priya.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ɔɹ aɪ kæn swɑp wɪθ ˈpɹijə/
dialogue.zh: 當然。不然我可以跟普莉雅對調。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait—she has no meetings today!
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ʃi hæz noʊ ˈmitɪŋz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，她今天剛好沒排會議！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can message her right now, if that helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ˈmɛsɪdʒ hɚ ɹaɪt naʊ ɪf ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 需要的話，我馬上傳訊息給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let's try that. She runs meetings well.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɛts tɹaɪ ðæt ʃi ɹʌnz ˈmitɪŋz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣辦。她主持會議很有一套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. I'll send her the slides, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt aɪl sɛnd hɚ ðə slaɪdz tu/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。簡報我也一併傳給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. How many sick days did you use this year?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt haʊ ˈmɛni sɪk deɪz dɪd ju juz ðɪs jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 完美。你今年用掉幾天病假了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I think just one, back in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ θɪŋk dʒʌst wʌn bæk ɪn mɑɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，算算只有一次，在三月初。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use today. No guilt, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juz təˈdeɪ noʊ ɡɪlt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就安心用掉今天。別自責，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. I feel much better now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪ fil mʌtʃ ˈbɛtɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我這下心裡踏實多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Does the school need anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm dʌz ðə skul nid ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。學校還有別的要求嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They want a doctor's note on Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɑnt ə ˈdɑktɚz noʊt ɑn ˈmʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他們要週一再補一張醫生證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We need one here too, after two days.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid wʌn hɪɹ tu ˈæftɚ tu deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 公司請病假滿兩天，也要附證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. Clinic visit booked for eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ ˈklɪnɪk ˈvɪzɪt bʌkt fɔɹ ɪˈlɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 幸好你提醒。我約了十一點看診。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, you're ahead of me. Nicely done.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jʊɹ əˈhɛd əv mi ˈnaɪsli dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，你都排在前面了。安排得真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leo gets sick the first week of fall every year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlioʊ ɡɛts sɪk ðə fɜɹst wiːk ʌv fɔl ˈɛvɹi jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 唉，利奧每年入秋的第一週必病。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine was the same. Germs love classrooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn wʌz ðə seɪm dʒɜɹmz lʌv ˈklæsˌɹumz/
dialogue.zh: 我家那孩子也一樣。細菌最愛教室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before I forget—the Torres file went out.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ fɚˈɡɛt ðə təˈɹɛs ˈfaɪl wɛnt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 趁我還沒忘，托雷斯那份檔案已經寄出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Anything else open on your desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ɛls ˈoʊpən ɑn jʊɹ dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你手上還有沒結的案子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just the quote for Chen's order.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə kloʊt fɔɹ tʃɛnz ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只剩小陳那張訂單的報價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll ask Priya to grab that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æsk ˈpɹijə tə ɡɹæb ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那我請普莉雅接手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll need the price sheet, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi lɪd nid ðə pɹaɪs ʃit ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過她會需要價目表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on the shared drive, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn ðə ʃɛɹd dɹaɪv ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 表在共用硬碟裡，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, under Sales, folder two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈʌndɚ seɪlz ˈfoʊldɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 對，業務資料夾，第二個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. I'll point her there now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt aɪl pɔɪnt hɚ ðɛɹ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我馬上指路給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're making this easy, Diane. Really.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðɪs ˈizi daɪæn ˈɹiəli/
dialogue.zh: 你把整件事變得輕鬆許多，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the job. Now, how is the little guy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə dʒɑb naʊ haʊ ɪz ðə ˈlɪtəl ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 分內之事。對了，小傢伙現在怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleeping on my shoulder, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslipɪŋ ɑn maɪ ˈʃoʊldɚ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，他正趴在我肩上睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aww. Don't wake him, take it slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔ doʊnt weɪk hɪm teɪk ɪt sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 噢。別吵醒他，動作放慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll whisper the rest of this call.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈwɪspɚ ðə ɹɛst ʌv ðɪs kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那接下來這幾句，我都小聲說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, okay. Message me after the clinic.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ oʊˈkeɪ ˈmɛsɪdʒ mi ˈæftɚ ðə ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈好。看完診再傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. And thanks for taking care of this.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du ænd θæŋks fɔɹ ˈteɪkɪŋ ˈkɛɹ‿əv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 一定。也謝謝你把這一切打點好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Team thing. Get yourselves some soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /tim θɪŋ ɡɛt jɔɹˈsɛlvz sʌm sup/
dialogue.zh: 團隊嘛。你們記得弄點湯喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chicken soup is Leo's medicine anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪkɪn sup ɪz ˈlioʊz ˈmɛdəsəni ˈɛnɪˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 反正雞湯就是利奧的特效藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here. Soup works every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪɹ saʊp wɜɹks ˈɛvɹi taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我們家也一樣，每次都有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm off to the clinic. Bye, Diane.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪm ɔf tə ðə ˈklɪnɪk baɪ daɪæn/
dialogue.zh: 好，我要帶他出門看診了。再見，黛安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, Kevin. Give Leo a big get-well hug.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈkɛvɪn ɡɪv ˈlioʊ ə bɪɡ ˈɡɛt‿wɛl hʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 再見凱文。替我給利奧一個大大的康復擁抱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. See you online at one, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl si ju ˈɑnˌlaɪn æt wʌn ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。一點說不定線上見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No pressure. Rest up, both of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɛʃɚ ɹɛst ʌp boθ ʌv ju/
dialogue.zh: 別有壓力。你們兩人都好好休息。

script.youtube_description:
孩子發燒、學校上午就把他送回家，這班還怎麼上？這一集用60句自然英文，帶你聽懂一通最真實的請假電話：向主管說明情況、請求下午在家辦公、請同事接手主持會議、確認檔案位置，最後連雞湯話題都暖心收尾。

你會聽到：
- 開場有禮道歉：「Sorry to call so early.」
- 在家辦公的請求：「Could I work from home this afternoon?」
- 找人代主持：「Or I can swap with Priya.」
- 病假與證明的規則：「We need one here too, after two days.」

這些句型在美式職場天天都在用，聽熟就能開口。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先聽完整段對話，再一句一句模仿，讓句子自然變成口語直覺。

願你每次請假，都能安心又順利。

script.youtube_description_en:
A sick child, a school phone call, and a meeting at ten: this episode is a phone call every working parent knows. In 60 short lines you hear a dad tell his boss what happened, ask to work from home in the afternoon, swap the client meeting with a teammate, check open tasks, and finish with warm small talk about chicken soup.

You will learn polite openers, sick day and work from home requests, coverage phrases, doctor's note rules, and friendly sign-offs. Everything stays at A2 level, with everyday American speech, contractions and fillers.

The second half is line-by-line listening plus shadowing practice, so the phrases stick without memorizing.

Made for A2 learners, parents, and office workers.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new daily-life English listening video every week.

📌 影片簡介：
小孩發燒了，十分鐘後得打給主管請假，第一句話該怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走進一通真實的請假電話：從有禮的開場、說明孩子生病、請求在家辦公，到請同事接手會議、交代檔案位置，每個環節都用短句慢慢說。

你會聽到：
📞 開場道歉：「Good morning, Diane. Sorry to call so early.」
🏠 在家辦公：「Could I work from home this afternoon?」
🤝 找人接手：「Or I can swap with Priya.」
💼 工作交代：「It's on the shared drive, right?」

這一集還講了病假天數與醫生證明的公司規矩，以及如何用一碗雞湯的閒聊溫暖收尾。

script.thumbnail_action: holding a phone with a sleeping child on his shoulder
